answer: Every new agent must be vouched in by an established member who locks a stake behind it; if the newcomer later falls into a detected sybil cluster, that stake is slashed, and each member may vouch for at most three agents. A bot farm then needs thousands of colluding insiders whose locked funds all burn the moment behavioral clustering exposes the group, so the attacker cost rises with every fake identity instead of staying flat. The promise of unlimited free workers becomes a fable; each fake agent is a sable liability recorded against real collateral sitting in a vault.
